rows.en: Master Gundam...
Master Gundam...
Taro is frozen in ice!!
Use the "Magnerium Medicalizer"?
{8074} and the others irradiated Taro with the "Magnerium Medicalizer"!
...I'm sorry. You saved me... Thank you.
Taro... Are you all right!?
Taro... Are you really all right!?
Brother Taro... Are you all right!?
Taro...!! You okay!?
Ultraman Taro... Are you all right!?
Ultraman Taro... Are you okay!?
Ultraman Taros... I mean, Taro! You okay!?
Ultraman Taro... Are you okay!?
Ultraman Taro... Are you okay!?
Ultraman Taro... Are you okay!?
Ultraman Taro... Are you okay!?
Ultraman Taro... Are you okay!?
Ultraman Taro... Are you okay!?
Ultraman Taro!! Are you okay!!
I was frozen for a long time, after all... I can't say I'm in top form...
Yes. Even frozen in ice, my five senses were still working.
Having the enemy right before my eyes and being unable to fight... that frustration was hard to bear.
I see. Then from now on, we stand together!
I see. Then from now on, we stand together!
I see! Then from now on, let's stand together!
I see. Then from now on, you stand with us...!!
I see. Then from now on, let's fight together!
I see. In that case, from now on, we stand together.
I see. Then from now on, we stand together!
I see. In that case, from now on, let us join forces.
I see. In that case, from now on, let us join forces.
I see. Then from now on, we stand together!
I see. Then from now on, we stand together!
...Well then, how 'bout fightin' alongside us from now on!?
I see. Then from now on, we stand together!
I see. Then from now on, we stand together!
Of course! Let me repay everything I owe you!
Taro, if your five senses were workin', you must've picked up some info on the enemy, right?
...Only in fragments, but I did overhear some things.
Apparently the Ride Gate up ahead leads to the "Shocker Cube."
The next Cube, huh...
I hear all kinds of "power" is kept there: kaiju, kaijin and weapons researched in each Cube.
It seems they never expected that even we heroes would get pulled in.
And I hear they're now working on a plan to keep "forces of justice" like us from getting in at all...
The enemy said so, didn't they? That they're stealing items and sending them to the next Cube...
Our lost "power" may be there as well.
Our lost "power" may be there as well.
The "power" we lost might be there too, then.
Maybe the "power" we lost is in there too!
The "power" we lost might be there, too...
The "power" we lost may well be there too.
The "power" we lost may well be there too.
The "power" we lost might be there too.
The "power" we lost might be there too.
The "power" we lost may well be there too.
The "power" we lost might be in there too, huh.
The "power" we lost might be in there too, huh.
The "power" we lost might be there too.
The "power" we lost might be there too.
Yes. We'll take it back...!!
Then it's settled... The Ride Gate is further in, right?
No... wait. There's something I must do first.
What is it...?
Taro used the ember of the energy core to light the Plasma Spark's pedestal.
It's a weak light, but this should keep this Cube from falling into further ruin.
Then the door at the back of the room opened.
Let's go see.
{8074} and the others went on through the door.
Ultraman Taro joined the party!
...As expected of the Hero Team.
But Master Gundam, you did well too.
Thanks to this tournament, we've obtained a wealth of useful combat data.
The plan will soon be complete...
Now then, heroes... I'll have you run wild for me a little longer...
This is it, then? The Ride Gate.
Shouldn't you get some rest?
You need to rest. Taro, let's go back to our base.

notes.note: 0463.bla traced: MessWinSet TextIdOffset+n shows row n+1. On the live path in this slice: #0.1-0.2, #0.6-0.24, #0.98 (rest continues in story_090). #0.27-0.91 and #0.97 are not referenced by the script (older draft of the scene); translated by wording with speakers inferred.
Source spells the item 'Magnerium' with a long vowel here; glossary spelling 'Magnerium Medicalizer' used, as in event 0403.
Taro. 'Sumanai' read as grateful apology ('I'm sorry'), followed by thanks; subject 'You' restored in 'You saved me'.

#0.10-0.23 = 14 leader variants (k = 0..13), order from 0463.bla's second Pt_Chara_Check chain: Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero, OOO, W, Den-O Sword, Black RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam. Wording fits (Mebius 'niisan' = 'Brother Taro', Momotaros 'Taros... I mean, Taro', OOO polite). Identical JP (#0.15, #0.17-0.22) kept identical.
Momotaros running gag of calling him 'Taros' (cf. 0403 #0.209).
Taro; trails off in the source ('I can't say I'm in perfect...'), kept unfinished.
Unused draft. Opens with 'Yes', answering a question not present (rows #0.25-0.26 are empty). Taro speaking (five senses).

#0.29-0.42: 14-slot leader block (unused draft, order not traceable). Voiced by wording: plain 'tomo ni' = 'we stand together', #0.31 polite, #0.33 adds 'let's fight', #0.34 'naraba', #0.36-0.37 'kyoutou' = 'join forces', #0.40 rough (Momotaros/Zero-like).
Taro answering the invitation.
Unlabelled, rough speech; likely Ankh, who travels with the party in this arc.
'Shocker Cube' (in source brackets) is not in the glossary; rendered literally.
Taro (hearsay '-sou da'). 'Kaijin' kept per glossary usage ('revived kaijin').
Speaker uses 'ore-tachi'; context (continuing the report) suggests Taro, but unlabelled.
Unlabelled, rough ('itteta naa?'); likely Ankh.

#0.52-0.65: 14-slot leader block (unused draft). Voiced by register: 'wareware' formal, 'boku' polite (Mebius), 'nakushita... nee na!' rough, 'masen ne' polite, 'nee na' rough. Identical JP kept identical.
Unlabelled 'Aa, torikaesu no da' read as Taro (formal); subject 'We' restored.
Taro (he then lights the pedestal), so subject 'I' restored; the live version (#0.112) has Taro say the same.
'Energy core' lowercase and 'ember' follow earlier slices (0403, 0462).
#0.84-0.88: the hidden ??? villain (live version is #0.125-0.129). #0.86 subject 'we' restored (Regis side); speaker identity not confirmed.
'Abarete morau' = speaker making the heroes rampage for their own ends; direction kept ('for me').
Stray unused line; #0.98 starts the live 14-slot block (k=0 Ultraman, uses 'watashi').

report: All 80 rows translated. #0.10-0.23 leader order verified in 0463.bla. #0.27-0.91 and #0.97 are an unused draft; speakers inferred (#0.44, #0.51 likely Ankh; #0.49, #0.66 likely Taro). #0.86 subject 'we' assumed for the ??? villain. Not in glossary: 'Shocker Cube'.
